reference_combine_justification: Each session graph is built independently with timed update_graph, then converted to a shares-not-counts dense tensor. R_k is the equal-weight arithmetic mean of session tensors 1..k. Sessions contribute equally (event-count does not overweight long traces); distances stay on the normalised scale used for GAE feeds; Stage-3 channel variants differ only in which adjacency channel(s) enter the tensor.
